scope: FYH512 lab only; correction B only; no production, channels or translation changes

generic_choice_before_evaluation.choice: integrate adjacent-landmark correction proposals as ordinary candidates in the existing constrained DP
generic_choice_before_evaluation.selection: same novelty salience and distance penalty as every other candidate; no correction bonus and no post-DP overwrite
generic_choice_before_evaluation.acceptance: accepted only when selected by the global DP objective and present unchanged in the final verified path
generic_choice_before_evaluation.rejection: report exact shared-constraint cause when infeasible, otherwise objective_not_better_than_selected_dp
generic_choice_before_evaluation.valid_but_not_best_tradeoff: preserve the globally better DP path; retain landmark presence only as corridor evidence and do not claim the proposed timestamp was accepted

single_source_of_truth: one transition problem builds theoretical boundaries, corridor radii, local minimum gaps, valid candidates and global gaps; solving and final verification consume that exact object
frozen_off_control: voice-disabled landmark-only A path remains byte-exact at e0200bae... and is an out-of-scope control, not a B selection route

voice_policy.candidate_source: automatic replay of the exact 10 frozen ASR events

joint_selection_a_preserved.on_limit: explicit exception and abstention; no truncated optimum claim

reference_cache.required_inventory: exact 22 URL/SHA-256/byte triples frozen from base A

evaluation.regression_policy: report refusal and stop before any variant
